text:
Kuch baatein honthon tak aakar hi ruk gayi,
Tumne pucha nahi, maine kuch kaha nahi।
Faasle chahe jitne bhi rahein darmiyaan,
Par tumse mohabbat ka silsila kabhi ruka nahi।
title: Unkahe Ehsaas
description: A soft and heartfelt social media post about silent love and unexpressed feelings for a general Indian audience.
